description:
Discover timeless elegance with this beautiful Pakistani ensemble by Aiman, featuring a dusty rose base, intricate silver-gold embroidery, delicate floral motifs, pearl embellishments, and decorative button detailing.


Product Details

  • Brand: Aiman

  • Collection: Soiree D4

  • Color: Dusty Rose with Silver-Gold Accents

  • Outfit: 3-Piece Suit

  • Kameez: Raw silk shirt featuring intricate embroidery, hand embellishments, and elegant pearl details.

  • Trouser: Coordinated embroidered Farshi shalwar in raw silk.

  • Dupatta: Tissue dupatta with diamante embellishments and an embroidered organza border.

  • Style: Elegant Pakistani Ethnic Wear

  • Occasion: Weddings, Eid, Festive Gatherings & Special Occasions


A graceful blend of soft rosy tones and luxurious traditional craftsmanship, perfect for an elegant statement look.
